liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Bertha** (2 reviews): The opening Bertha, with its jailhouse line, made the crowd go wild; Reviewer likes Bertha as an opener, with Jerry playing strongly [14][19]
- **Cumberland Blues** (2 reviews): The move from China Cat into Cumberland Blues caught everyone off guard; The surprise jump into Cumberland Blues from China Cat is thrilling [20][25]
- **I Need A Miracle** (1 other source): Vocals show slight saturation during Miracle, a flaw present on the master [6]
- **Space** (1 review): Space with Merl Saunders is singled out as the part truly worth getting excited about [25]

## The recordings

- **gd1985-03-09.176201.sbd.pcm.remaster.patched.miller.flac1644** (recommended): soundboard; 16 songs; 129 min [1]
- **gd1985-03-09.176457.sennheiser.blend.terry.miller.clugston.flac1648**: audience recording; 16 songs; 129 min [3]
- **gd1985-03-09.senn421.mccue.84027.sbeok.flac16**: source not stated; 16 songs; 133 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [5]
- **gd1985-03-09.pzm.unknown.26334.shnf**: source not stated; 16 songs; 130 min [6]. Said about its sound: Master tape has distortion on the first track, ending at 0:28 [6]
- **gd1985-03-09.sbd.quinn.97331.flac16**: soundboard; 16 songs; 125 min; rated 3/5 by 3 [8]. Said about its sound: Complete soundboard with correct speed and more natural fidelity, though the bass seems lighter [24]
- **gd85-03-09.aud.vernon.14448.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 16 songs; 126 min; rated 3.57/5 by 14 [10]. Said about its sound: The audience recording sounds distant and muffled [22]
- **gd1985-03-09.sbd.unknown.91881.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 16 songs; 111 min; rated 4/5 by 2 [11]. Said about its sound: This soundboard has a pitch problem and needs correction by a mastering expert [23]

## Around the show

- Reviewer says this was the first show after Jerry's arrest in Golden Gate Park [14]
- Reviewer says the Kaiser shows, not this one, were first after Jerry's Golden Gate Park bust [15]
- Cites Phil's book (pp. 271-272): the bust came after the winter tour and Kaiser shows, before spring tour [16]
- Says the Golden Gate Park bust was Jan 18, 1985, and the first show after it was Kaiser, Feb. 18, 1985 [17]
- Merl Saunders joins on Space, The Other One and Sugar Magnolia [1]
- The Twilight Zone theme is played during Space [1]
- Merl Saunders plays through Drums, Space and The Other One [3]
- The Twilight Zone theme appears during Space [3]
- Says '85 has better shows for both sound quality and band playing; this setlist is routine and short [22]
- Judged an improvement over the other soundboard of this show [24]
- Calls it an average, rushed-sounding 1985 show, though Berkeley usually brought out the band's best [25]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1985-03-09.176201.sbd.pcm.remaster.patched.miller.flac1644**: transferred by All Transfers and Mastering by Charlie Miller  February 3, 2026; source: SBD > PCM Master > DAT Clone (44.1k) [1]. Also: Buzz on It's All Over Now Baby Blue was cleaned up, using shnid 165109 [1]
- **gd1985-03-09.176457.sennheiser.blend.terry.miller.clugston.flac1648**: taped by Mark Terry; transferred by Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Mark Terry's Master Audience Cassettes; (2) Sennheiser 421 mics (L/R) + (1) Sennheiser 441 mic (C) blend > Nakamichi 550 > Sony D5 (Maxell XLII-S90) [3]
- **gd1985-03-09.senn421.mccue.84027.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Mark McCue; transferred by Alex Ford; source: MAC; Sennheiser 421s > Sony D5 > TDK MA90s [5]. Also: Sennheiser 421 mics to Sony D5 onto TDK MA90 cassettes; transferred via Nakamichi Dragon to FLAC16 [5]
- **gd1985-03-09.pzm.unknown.26334.shnf**: taped by Unknown; transferred by Unknown; source: Realistic PZM mics > Sony TC-D5M cassette deck > Maxell MX-90 cassettes [6]. Also: A three-second gap where the taper flipped the tape was removed; the Space track starts at the flip [6]
- **gd1985-03-09.sbd.quinn.97331.flac16**: transferred by Chris Quinn; source: Ssbd > ? > cassette (Maxell XLII) [8]
- **gd85-03-09.aud.vernon.14448.sbeok.shnf**: source: Audience Recording [10]
- **gd1985-03-09.sbd.unknown.91881.sbeok.flac16**: taped by thanks to jimbo05@LL for providing the recording; source: Soundboard [11]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Jerry Garcia: [1985-03-09 Ticket - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/image/1985-03-09-ticket/) [27]
